### A. Healthy Dart battery exhaustion and recovery

Continue a current earned installed-trim Dart branch. Prepare food, cells and a safe route using ordinary controls. Drain its healthy hull battery through actual movement to **zero charge with health greater than zero**. No seeded-zero substitution, idle time padding or charge edits. Current boosted movement drains a full battery in about 529 simulation seconds; SwiftShader wall time may differ. Normal quality settings may improve responsiveness, without a hardware-performance claim. Avoid colliding while moving fast and retain any actual missteps honestly.
